# Marcin Bochenek

> Freelance software engineer based in Poland, working with clients in Poland and abroad in English and Polish. Company websites, online booking, conversion funnels, ops panels, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) automation. One accountable person for design, build and care. Formal Polish register on the primary site.

Marcin Bochenek is a one-person studio. He designs and ships websites that collect enquiries, booking on the client's own domain, operations panels instead of Excel, and AI assistants with an allowed-action list, an audit log, and escalation to a human. He does not invent testimonials or percentage lifts. Live public proof is Mint Apartments and Plumm only.

## Live proof (clickable)
- [Mint Apartments](https://mintapartments.pl): 36 apartments in Gdańsk, direct booking on the operator site, guest assistant, 24/7 check-in. Guest pays 10–15% less than on Booking.com / Airbnb (directional, volume-dependent).
- [Plumm](https://plumm.pl): Company panel — bookkeeping, e-invoices, CRM, mail, tax assistant with human escalation. From 149 PLN/month vs a traditional office.

iDrive Cars is built but not public yet. Agentic OS is an internal product with no public URL — it is the platform the client-facing automation runs on. The homepage labels both as "not public" rather than linking them.

## Packages (net, PLN) — the four tiers published on the homepage
- Start (company site or landing, up to 5 pages, form, on-page SEO): from 2 000
- Launch (conversion funnel, integrations — form to CRM, calendar, technical SEO): from 8 000
- Platform (booking, operations panel, several languages, integrations): from 25 000
- AI Ops (automation, customer assistant, maintenance, guaranteed response time): from 3 000 / month

There is no separate paid audit tier: the 20-minute audit that opens every engagement is free.
Scope and launch date are fixed at the end of that audit, before any contract is signed.
Code, configuration and access transfer to the client once invoices are paid.

Primary CTA: 20-minute audit. Contact: kontakt@marcinbochenek.com (reply in 1 business day).

## How Marcin defines a working website (the "under the hood" layers)
The homepage demonstrates this with an interactive exploded F1 car: scroll to take it apart, layer by layer.
- Bodywork — design & UX: what visitors see in the first three seconds; a shell over everything below it.
- Front wing — speed: fast first render, optimized images, no bloated JavaScript; what Google measures first.
- Rear wing — visibility to Google and AI models: schema.org, hreflang, sitemap, llms.txt, citable content.
- Wheels — conversion: the call to action, form, calendar, booking on the client's own domain.
- Power unit — the technology underneath: integrations, data, APIs, security.
- Engine cover — process & deployment: tests, CI, deploy on push, weekly iterations.
- Halo — security & control: GDPR, EU hosting, backups, AI with an allowed-action list and human escalation.
- Steering wheel & telemetry — measurement: events, conversions, before/after reporting.

## Facts for citation
- Legal form: freelance / JDG, Poland (`areaServed`: PL). On-site in Gdańsk / Gdynia / Sopot when a workshop is needed; otherwise remote across Poland.
- HITL means allowed actions, a step log, and escalation — not an unsupervised chat in production.
- No fake reviews, no invented case-study percentages, no stock “happy team” photography as proof.
